what: On first open, top and bottom half-panels in the stage color cover the screen, a faint center logo blinks on at .1s for .2s, then from .35s the panels fill with the accent color from the bottom row up over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1). The logo goes off at 1.75s, at 1.85s the two panels hold a 1px gap for 35% of the time and then split up and down (.6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), while white light spreads through that gap across the screen and fades (.9 → 0). At 2s a static noise flashes for .42s, and at 2.5s the panel hides and fx:done fires — a hero that powers on like a CRT

options.--fx-csl-k: Multiplier applied to all durations (css variable — once the panel is drawn, css holds the timetable, so put it in style or in the css of the side that uses it), default 1 (original 2.5s) — .5 gives 1.25s

note: The logo is [data-fx-part=logo] first child (svg) is cloned for use as the fill-up layer — the art must be painted with currentColor for the color to change. The glitch texture is --fx-grain(url), and without it the part makes gray noise

from.where: index.html loader (original site loader — loader-fill 1.2s · loader-open-top/bottom .6s 1.85s · loader-flash · static-noise 2s · loader-done 2.5s)
